title: Trust Fall Tim's TRUST Token Crashes 99.97% - "I Didn't Expect Anyone to Catch Me"
body: In an exclusive interview, Tim explained that the token was meant to be "a metaphor for trust in financial systems." It was not.
summary: TRUST token collapses as creator Trust Fall Tim offers metaphysical excuses.
